title: Rodriguez Falls in Line With U.S? Trump Announces Partnership with Venezuela Govt Post Maduro's Fall
text: Rodriguez Falls in Line With U.S? Trump Announces Partnership with Venezuela Govt Post Maduro’s FallPresident Donald Trump announced a strengthening of ties with the new Venezuelan government led by Delcy Rodríguez following the ouster of Nicolás Maduro. Trump said they discussed areas like oil, minerals, trade, and national security, and described the talks as “tremendous progress” as Washington seeks to help stabilize Venezuela and support recovery. Both leaders portrayed their communication as productive, with Trump praising Rodríguez and emphasizing cooperation to benefit both nations. Critics note that Venezuela’s interim government must balance U.S. demands, including potential economic alignment and access to resources, with internal challenges and geopolitical pressures.
